# Multi-Agent Research Assistant

> Open-source multi-agent research platform by Aditya Mhaske. Planner, Researcher, Critic and Synthesizer agents with human-in-the-loop approval, per-claim citations, and BYOK support. Built with LangGraph, FastAPI, Next.js.
